name: Human Resources (HR)
description: The human resources department deals with the management of the human resources of the student branch. The main responsibilities are the communication with the new members and their smooth integration into the student branch. It also deals with internal communications, organization of its members, etc.

name: Fund Raising (FR)
description: The fundraising section aims to seek and collect funds or resources for activities of the student branch. Communicates with companies and organizations in order to find sponsorships for the student branch such as the provision of equipment to the club's teams, food at events, merchandise sponsorships, etc.
